name: @w6w-apps/tapfiliate
description: Manage affiliate programs, affiliates, customers, conversions, commissions and payments through the Tapfiliate REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Tapfiliate is an affiliate marketing platform: programs define how affiliates are paid, affiliates promote via referral links or coupons, and customers/conversions they bring in generate commissions that flow into payments.

This app covers that whole lifecycle — creating and managing affiliates, affiliate groups and prospects; tracking customers and conversions and attributing them to an affiliate via referral code, coupon, click id or tracking id; adding, approving and disapproving commissions; enrolling and approving affiliates into programs; and recording or cancelling payments. A small clicks surface (Enterprise-plan-only per the vendor's own docs) supports a REST-only tracking integration with no JS snippet.

Health checks track Tapfiliate's own status page (a SorryApp-hosted page, anchored on its "Tapfiliate API" component specifically) alongside the account's live rate-limit headroom.
